scope: Entire workers/client.ts, publication.ts, serialization.ts, acknowledgement_buffer.ts and deferral_buffer.ts. Scheduler, worker definitions, provider and storage implementations are dependencies rather than mutated sources.

bugEvidence.before: Two new acknowledgement regressions failed against the original source: flush settled while a sibling queue ack remained pending, and only the first queue failure survived. Public gated probes independently reproduced the early completion.
bugEvidence.fix: Wait for every queue-group acknowledgement with Promise.allSettled, propagate a single original cause or AggregateError containing every group failure. Existing successful callbacks remain after durable writes.
bugEvidence.tests: Three new acknowledgement drain/aggregation cases plus one pendingCount case; seven publication contract cases and one multi-chunk deferral case.
